body.x: CieL-S participated in the Future Innovation Tech Expo 2024 (FIX 2024) at Daegu EXCO from October 23 to 26.

CieL-S is a technology-focused company that provides services for automotive testing and analysis and develops in-wheel motors and reducers for electric vehicles. The company offers a comprehensive benchmarking solution for electric vehicle development.

At the exhibition, the company introduced its Transmission 3D Software, which enables the development of numerical analysis models specialized in transmissions for industries such as automotive, aerospace, marine, wind power, defense, and agricultural machinery. Based on finite element and boundary element methods, the software provides detailed contact mechanics analysis for gear meshing and bearings.

The software allows for optimized gear design, durability life evaluations, and impact assessments of deformation and errors on durability and vibration noise. It supports advanced gear analysis design and offers features like unbalancedness analysis, bearing race damage assessment, and nonlinear gear rim durability and vibration contribution analysis. The software also includes modeling functionality, calculation results, and post-processing capabilities.

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
